value.answer: Call 911 now if this is happening or just happened - even though a brief seizure with fever in a toddler is often a febrile seizure, any seizure needs urgent medical checking, especially since she is now floppy and drowsy.
value.triage: Call 911 or go to the ER right away for this seizure - do not wait. If she is now recovering, still fully alert, and this was her only seizure with fever, you can call Health811 (811) after for next-step advice, but a first seizure or one lasting a minute always needs emergency assessment.
